observations: A 2008–2009 telephone survey of 1,674 deployed Ohio Army National Guard members found greater perceived unit support associated with lower odds of deployment-related sexual harassment and sexual assault; abstract did not provide adjusted effect estimates.

entities.name: Unit support and Guard sexual harm
observations: In an observational Ohio Army National Guard survey, greater perceived unit support was associated with lower odds of sexual harassment and sexual assault during the most recent deployment; causality and effect magnitude remain uncertain.
